# QR Code generator — Project Nayuki

- Version: **1.8.0**, precompiled ES6 JavaScript release.
- License: **MIT**, retained in full in the header of `qrcodegen.js`.
- Project/documentation: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Pinned upstream artifact: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js
- Local SHA-256 (LF line endings): `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`.

The library is served locally; it does not receive project links over a third-party service. `public/js/buzon-public-link.js` encodes the existing signed URL and renders black modules on a white canvas, with a four-module quiet zone and a separate project-code caption. It offers the canvas as a PNG download. No PHP extension, Composer dependency or production build is needed for this asset.
